class.name: OcgBreptoolsReshape
class.brief_description: Rebuilds a Shape by making pre-defined substitutions on some of its components
class.description: ! Rebuilds a Shape by making pre-defined substitutions on some ! of its components ! ! In a first phase, it records requests to replace or remove ! some individual shapes ! For each shape, the last given request is recorded ! Requests may be applied "Oriented" (i.e. only to an item with ! the SAME orientation) or not (the orientation of replacing ! shape is respectful of that of the original one) ! ! Then, these requests may be applied to any shape which may ! contain one or more of these individual shapes ! ! Supports the 'BRepTools_History' history by method 'History'.

method.name: Remove
method.description: Sets a request to Remove a Shape whatever the orientation

method.name: Replace
method.description: Sets a request to Replace a Shape by a new one.

method.name: IsRecorded
method.description: Tells if a shape is recorded for Replace/Remove

method.name: Value
method.description: Returns the new value for an individual shape If not recorded, returns the original shape itself If to be Removed, returns a Null Shape Else, returns the replacing item

method.name: Status
method.description: Returns a complete substitution status for a shape 0 : not recorded, <newsh> = original <shape> < 0: to be removed, <newsh> is NULL > 0: to be replaced, <newsh> is a new item If <last> is False, returns status and new shape recorded in the map directly for the shape, if True and status > 0 then recursively searches for the last status and new shape.

method.name: Apply
method.description: Applies the substitutions requests to a shape.

method.name: ModeConsiderLocation
method.description: Returns (modifiable) the flag which defines whether Location of shape take into account during replacing shapes.

method.name: History
method.description: Returns the history of the substituted shapes.
